title_en: “First failure is a real asset”... Sandy Floor leads the indie game market ‘Resurrection of the Losers’
summary_en: [GD Net Korea] In the indie game market, failure of the first project usually leads to the disbandment of the development team. The reality is that it is difficult to get a chance to try again due to the skepticism that "the first game didn't work, so will the second game?" This is why domestic indie game studio Sandy Floor is expanding its business beyond self-development to publishing. Sandy Floor CEO Lee Jong-chang, who met at the 'Busan Indie Connect Festival (BIC) 2026' on the 16th, said, "Even though I poured all my capabilities into my first work, I couldn't get a follow-up opportunity. “Sometimes talented developers leave the industry,” he said, adding, “Developers who have experienced failure are key assets in the industry, and the company’s goal is to establish itself as a publisher that provides them with a ‘second chance.’” Sandy Floor also failed to meet expectations with its first work. CEO Lee explained, “I learned the most from my first failure,” and “I was able to make the second game better because I reviewed what I failed to do.” That second work is the BIC entry ‘Peng Pong.’ It received both the best game award and the audience vote award at last year's G-Star Indie Awards. title_en: “Physical AI experimental site”… Seoul AI Hub holds hackathon ‘Toython’
summary_en: [GD Net Korea] Seoul AI Hub is conducting an experiment to connect codes written with generative artificial intelligence (AI) to actual hardware (HW) such as sensors and development boards. Seoul AI Hub announced on the 16th that it will hold a physical AI hackathon 'Toython' at the Seoul AI Hub Main Center in Yangjae-dong, Seoul on the 22nd. Team Human, Nucode, and Korea Investment Accelerator are participating in the event, and ChatGPT developer OpenAI is participating as an official sponsor. Participants use AI development tools and Nucode development boards to carry out the entire process from idea planning to code development and HW connection. The method is to complete a prototype that actually moves and reacts in about 5 hours. This event is a follow-up to the 'Cursor Hackathon Seoul Volume 3' held last June. If the event at the time focused on 'vibe coding', which quickly implements web and application services with generative AI, this time it expands the area to HW such as sensors, buttons, light-emitting diodes (LEDs), and displays. Participants connect various input/output devices to Nucode's 'NU40 DK' and 'NU87 Tiny DK' development boards and develop control codes with AI. By using a connector-type development board, even participants with little experience in embedded development or soldering can create a working product.

title_source: 다쏘시스템, '융합형 엔지니어' 키운다…주요 성과는

title_en: Dassault Systèmes nurtures ‘convergence engineers’… The main achievements are
summary_en: [GDNet Korea] Dassault Systèmes is working to foster convergence engineering talent by supporting education that solves real industrial tasks through simulation. Students can develop problem-solving capabilities required in the industrial field by crossing design, fluid dynamics, structural analysis, and materials engineering. On the 16th, Dassault Systèmes disclosed an example of operating an engineering education program using the '3D Experience' platform at the Computational Prototyping and Research Center (CPARC) at Marmion Academy in Illinois, USA. Participating students carry out real-world projects presented by industry, ranging from cutting-edge simulation research to complex manufacturing challenges. Dassault Systèmes 'Simulia' is used to analyze the physical behavior of system units such as computational fluid dynamics and finite element analysis. 'Biobia' examines the properties of materials at the molecular level. CPARC does not teach design, fluid dynamics, structural analysis, and materials engineering separately. Students reflect the material properties identified at the molecular level in large-scale design simulations and comprehensively analyze the impact of each field on system performance. Students can also verify assumptions used in the design process based on simulation results. After finding variables that have a significant impact on performance, evaluate the design based on these and conduct the next research...

title_en: [SW Kit] Dassault Systèmes ‘Virtual Twin’, connected to future mobility design and production
summary_en: [GD Net Korea] Virtual Twin is emerging as a core infrastructure for future mobility development. Going beyond simple vehicle design, the production process and actual driving environment are virtually verified to reduce design errors and reduce the time and cost of product development. According to the IT industry on the 16th, startups and manufacturers that have difficulty securing large-scale manpower and production facilities have recently been using virtual twins as their core development infrastructure. With Virtual Twin, there is a trend to verify complex electric vehicle systems in a virtual environment before actually manufacturing them, and to understand in advance the impact of design changes on the manufacturing process and performance. The '3D Experience (3DX) platform', which integrates Dassault Systèmes' virtual twin technology, can connect product design, simulation, manufacturing, and data management into a single cloud-based environment. The impact of design changes on vehicle performance and production processes can also be verified prior to actual production. Harbinger of the United States, Bozankaya of Turkey, Mila Group of France, and Numeros Motors of India are developing electric commercial vehicles, eco-friendly public transportation, self-driving shared shuttles, and last-mile electric scooters, respectively, using the 3DX platform. They use Dassault Systèmes Virtual Twin technology to manage complex development processes and integrated production data...

title_en: Anthropic explains how Claude's "invisible watermark" works "If it's completely rewritten, it will disappear"
summary_en: Anthropic has announced a mechanism for embedding digital watermarks into text generated by Claude. It is a method that uses a secret key to generate random numbers and leaves a statistical pattern, so it does not affect quality, speed, or price. Although the aim is to comply with the EU AI Act, it is applied worldwide and also clearly states its limitations, such as the difficulty of entering it in codes or short sentences.
